name: The Splitbough Grove
region_detail: Along the margins of the Greenmantle woods, near established logging grounds.
site_type: grove | Inhabited locations; ancient sites | Sacred Velthari grove and disputed logging site.
history: Velthari families have cultivated the grove for generations, training the branches of its oldest trees into living arches and planting young trees to commemorate agreements between neighboring communities. Cadorian timbermen recently obtained cutting rights encompassing the grove under a charter based partly upon deeds acquired from the Briarhearth Freeholds.
current_state: Timber crews have felled several of the outer trees and begun marking others for removal. Work at the grove has halted following an intervention by Velthari wardens. The remaining trees, the felled timber, and the surviving boundary marks provide evidence that may help establish whether the charter was unlawfully issued or its limits exceeded.
inhabitants: Visiting Velthari wardens; a small timber crew and its foreman; occasional surveyors and Blackthorn patrols.
danger_level: Low ordinarily; moderate to high if armed groups confront one another.
points_of_interest:
Living arches; felled boundary trees; young commemorative plantings; discarded survey stakes; stacked timber; a temporary woodcutters’ shelter.

Unresolved elements: The precise extent and validity of the concession; Which boundary marks predate the charter and what agreements they record; Whether further cutting, retaliation, or negotiation occurs.
discovery: Along the margins of the Greenmantle woods, near established logging grounds. The Forest Office holds the relevant timber charter. Velthari guides and timber workers know the approaches to the grove.
related_records:
Faction Plot: P-003 — The Bloodwood Concession — Direct. The grove is among the sacred lands encompassed by the disputed concession.
